info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Logistics Shipments Cancel-v5-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the cancellation of logistics shipments within the system. It allows users to initiate a cancellation request for specific shipments, ensuring that unnecessary shipments can be halted before they are fulfilled. This operation is particularly relevant for logistics managers and operational staff who need to efficiently manage shipment statuses in response to changing business needs. By using this API, businesses can enhance their logistical operations and reduce unnecessary costs associated with canceled shipments.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel an existing shipment. Ensure that the shipment is eligible for cancellation before proceeding. Successful cancellation will invalidate the shipment status and release any associated resources.

requestBody.description: Request payload to cancel a shipment. Ensure that the shipment ID is provided to process the cancellation appropriately.

201.description: Shipment cancellation request processed successfully. The shipment has been marked as canceled.

DeleteLogisticsShipmentsCancelRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for cancelling a shipment operation.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Reference number associated with the shipment cancellation.

resultId.description: Unique identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: Current state of the shipment after cancellation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information about the cancellation response.

audit.description: Audit details regarding the cancellation process.

DeleteLogisticsShipmentsCancelResponse_2.description: Response schema for the DELETE operation on shipments cancel.

createdBy.description: User who created the cancellation request.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the cancellation request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation request was made automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Information related to the audit trail of the cancellation request.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the amount of time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
